name: Dominion War
blurb: The Ultimate Dominion Mod: the Dominion takes the Ferengi's place. It plays with its own structure ladder (Vorta centres, Ketracel-White, the Founders' Sanctuary, the Changeling Shapeshifter Network), Founders and Vorta traits and the Jem'Hadar line. Bajor replaces the Edo and new minors join. Scripted war to come.
